answer: Flooding registration pushes anyone to the back of the garden queue while genuine members promoted earlier still earns. Admission is quota-limited: at most 1479 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the opal. The prism index is deterministic from ledger replay, as a result nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. Honest users pay that once, farms 30 times. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
